label: Run current file
args: case "$ZED_FILE" in *.py) python3 "$ZED_FILE" ;; *.rs) if [ -f Cargo.toml ] || [ -f ../Cargo.toml ]; then cargo run; else rustc "$ZED_FILE" -o /tmp/rust_bin && /tmp/rust_bin; fi ;; *.c) gcc -O2 "$ZED_FILE" -o /tmp/c_bin && /tmp/c_bin ;; *.cpp|*.cc) g++ -O2 "$ZED_FILE" -o /tmp/cpp_bin && /tmp/cpp_bin ;; *.go) go run "$ZED_FILE" ;; *.js) node "$ZED_FILE" ;; *.ts) npx tsx "$ZED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || npx ts-node "$ZED_FILE" ;; *.sh) bash "$ZED_FILE" ;; *.lua) lua "$ZED_FILE" ;; *) echo "[Zed Runner] No runner configured for file: $ZED_FILE" ;; esac
